# Northstar Ops — GeoIntelligence & Service Operations Hub

> Parameterized GeoIntelligence platform and Atlassian Forge / Rovo MCP ecosystem for local service operators. Features a verified Radom case study (10–100 km radius, powered by real local pricing from pranie-dywanow.j.pl), dynamic OpenStreetMap + Wikidata discovery for any city worldwide, live SPA pricing extraction, AI competitor scanning, a cross-provider Multi-Model AI Council with human-in-the-loop constraints, and native Atlassian Forge Rovo Agent + Skill + MCP Server integration.

## Live Application & Endpoints

- [Interactive Web Hub](https://nsops.vercel.app/): Main dashboard for service coverage, competitor benchmarks, customer pricing calculator, and AI Strategy Council.
- [Web MCP Discovery](https://nsops.vercel.app/api/mcp): Model Context Protocol endpoint (`GET` discovery and `POST` JSON-RPC 2.0 `initialize`, `tools/list`, `tools/call`).
- [City & Surrounding Towns Geo Resolver](https://nsops.vercel.app/api/geo/resolve?city=Radom): OpenStreetMap and Wikidata geographic radius resolver (`GET`).
- [Live Website Pricing Extractor](https://nsops.vercel.app/api/pricing/sync?url=https://pranie-dywanow.j.pl/): Extracts live service pricing from operator websites (`GET`).
- [Live Competitor & Review Pain-Point Scanner](https://nsops.vercel.app/api/market/scan): AI-powered local competitor and review analysis (`POST`).
- [Cross-Provider Multi-Model AI Council](https://nsops.vercel.app/api/council): Multi-round AI strategy debate with human-in-the-loop constraints (`POST`).
- [Privacy Policy](https://nsops.vercel.app/privacy): Data handling and cookie preferences documentation.
- [Terms of Service](https://nsops.vercel.app/terms): Platform usage terms and service conditions.

## Documentation & Source Code

- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/AdamBabinicz/radom-geo-intelligence): Full source code for the Next.js hub and Atlassian Forge app.
- [Project README](https://github.com/AdamBabinicz/radom-geo-intelligence/blob/main/README.md): Architecture overview, setup guide, and testing instructions.
- [Atlassian Forge Manifest](https://github.com/AdamBabinicz/radom-geo-intelligence/blob/main/northstar-ops-rovo/manifest.yml): Forge `nodejs24.x` manifest declaring `rovo:agent`, `rovo:skill`, and `rovo:mcp`.
- [Rovo Strategist Skill](https://github.com/AdamBabinicz/radom-geo-intelligence/blob/main/northstar-ops-rovo/skills/geo-pricing-strategist/SKILL.md): Domain skill instructions for pricing and localized campaign planning.

## Web App MCP Tools (`/api/mcp`)

- `analyzeCompetitors({ center, radiusKm, industryId?, townsInRadius?, competitorsTracked?, locale? })` — Evaluates competitor price positioning, serviceable towns inside `radiusKm` (10–100), and customer review pain points.
- `calculateServiceFee({ town, orderValue })` — Computes zone travel surcharge and total customer quote in PLN for supported towns.
- `generateLocalizedCampaign({ season, targetTowns, industryId?, locale? })` — Generates localized go-to-market strategy copy tailored to verified customer pain points.
- `exportStrategyToConfluence({ center, radiusKm, season, industryId?, detectedIndustryLabel?, topPainPoint?, townsInRadius?, competitorsTracked?, benchmarks?, councilContext?, locale? })` — Publishes a live formatted Confluence strategy page via Atlassian REST API v2 (including AI Council debate audit trail when provided).
- `createJiraMarketingEpics({ center, radiusKm, industryId?, townsInRadius?, competitorsTracked?, councilContext?, locale? })` — Creates a Jira marketing Epic with localized town tasks and approved AI Council action items via Atlassian REST API v3.
- `createCustomerQuote({ center, town, serviceKey, serviceLabel?, quantity?, unitLabel?, unitPricePln, travelFeePln, totalPln, inZone?, locale? })` — Creates a live Jira customer quote task directly from the Customer Price Preview calculator.

## Atlassian Forge App (`northstar-ops-rovo/`)

- Forge Runtime: `nodejs24.x` (`Runs on Atlassian` eligible, zero external egress)
- Modules: `rovo:agent` (`northstar-ops-geo-strategist`), `rovo:skill` (`geo-pricing-strategist`), `rovo:mcp` (`northstar-ops-mcp`), and actions `get-market-brief`, `calculate-service-fee`, `publish-confluence-playbook`, `create-jira-campaign`
- Required scopes: `read:space:confluence`, `write:page:confluence`, `read:jira-work`, `write:jira-work`
